# Charset alias generation was a historical build dependency; current lookup uses an email alias table

The historical comm build moved props2arrays.py local when its upstream generator was removed. It emitted sorted key/value/value-length rows for charsetalias.properties.h. At the fixed accepted revision that script is absent; nsCharsetConverterManager instead has a literal email-only alias table and returns NS_ERROR_NOT_AVAILABLE with a cleared result if neither ordinary Web Encoding lookup nor the table matches. Keep these source states separate. Upstream-dependent ESR uplift and lint followups need their own tracking; no build or performance result was measured here.

Scope: Mailnews charset alias ownership.
